Shitet - Apartament 2+1 ne Farke
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje Kompleksit Rezidencial ne Farke.
Pozicionohet jo shume larg Liqenit te Farkes, vetem 6.5 km larg qendres se Tiranes, me dalje te menjehershme ne unazen e madhe.
Kompleksi perbehet nga 16 vila dhe 4 palacina 2 katshe.
Ndertimi eshte super cilesor.
Dopio tulle me lesh guri ne mes, izolim perfekt akustik dhe termik.
Vetratat triplex, alumin.
Shtrimi me parket druri
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 2-te.
Me siperfaqe totale 84.6 m2, siperfaqe neto 76.6 m2
Ka 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 dhome ndenjie, 1 tualet, 4 ballkone te vogla
Mundësi financimi deri në 70% pa kolateral ✅

description_en: For sale - 2+1 apartment in Farke. The apartment is part of a residential complex in Farke. It is positioned not far from Farka Lake, only 6.5 km from the center of Tirana, with immediate access to the big ring road. The complex consists of 16 villas and 4 2-story buildings. The construction is super quality. Double brick with stone wool in the middle, perfect acoustic and thermal insulation. Triplex windows, aluminum. Laying with wooden parquet The apartment is located on the 2nd floor. Total area 84.6 m2, net area 76.6 m2 There are 2 bedrooms, 1 living room, 1 bathroom, 4 small balconies Financing possibility up to 70% without collateral ✅ ID: 530201001-831
